name: Sabers
description: The Sabers were a Harlem-based teenage gang active in the 1940s. According to police, they frequently engaged in gun and knife battles. In May 1944, police intercepted gang members at a house party at 206 West 146th Street where they confiscated weapons.

sources.title: A Harlem Party, a Knock at the Door and a Smith & Wesson | New York City Fighting Gangs
